title: Agentic engineering
description: A hands-on guide to models, harnesses, tools, skills and operating agent workflows.
conventions: Work in disposable lab copies. Local exercises need Node 24 or later; live model and GitHub activities have separate access and cost requirements. Recorded or constructed examples are labelled. This rebuilt course is being published in complete workshop batches.

overview.headline: Understand your agents. Build workflows worth operating.
overview.introduction: Start inside an agent run, then develop the capabilities, execution machinery and operational practices behind useful AI workflows. The course connects a repository investigation, recurring maintenance and a coordinated migration.
overview.startingPoint: You already write software and use or build agents. Bring a terminal, Git and a willingness to inspect what your tools actually do.
